evidence.note: USA Wrestling identifies Victoria Francis as a U.S. women’s freestyle wrestler and describes her 2014 Junior World Championships result; lines 221–223 list her as silver medalist for the United States.
USADA’s 2018 notice names Victoria Francis, identifies wrestling, and reports age 24, consistent with the wrestler in the country source.
World Rowing profile identifies Keir Pearson and lists his 1992 Olympic Games men’s quadruple sculls result with country USA; the profile gives birth date 15/12/1966 at line 22.
USADA names Keir Pearson, identifies rowing, and reports age 54 in its May 2021 notice, consistent with the profile’s birth date.
